data.text:
‘HINDI TITIGIL HANGGA’T WALANG NAPAPANAGOT’

The Concerned Artists of the Philippines (CAP) holds its 4th consecutive Black Friday protest against corruption at Z Compound in Diliman, Quezon City on October 17, 2025. 

The group, joined by progressives, continues to call for accountability from corrupt government officials who plundered money at the expense of poor Filipinos affected by climate and man-made disasters. 

CAP launched the #Koraptober campaign at the beginning of the month and continues to invite artists to dedicate their talents for social justice. The artists’ collective will also hold ‘KORAPCHELLA’ on Sunday, October 19, ahead of the Peasant March on the 21st. On October 31, there will be a free anti-corruption Halloween event along Maginhawa St., Q.C. organized by CAP, together with progressive groups.
